items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1962-02-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's funny, he used Octave Crosby, I guess, when he went in the paddock.

ctx.x: And when he reorganized, well then I didn't become a member of his band at that time. I was still out. But I didn't rejoin until 53. Yes.
That's funny, he used Octave Crosby, I guess, when he went in the paddock. Well, that was the time, yes. Yes.
And Mercedes also. Well, Mercedes too. She was with him. I've never heard of her. Yeah, she's very, very good. She was with him during that period also.
